resources.string: Remembers feelings and life details across chats

When on, Min quietly keeps notes about how you are doing and the details of your life, so every new chat can pick up where you left off. Notes are written in the background by a model you choose, separately from the conversation, and are stored only inside this app. Running chats are not interrupted; new chats see a read-only copy.
On: new chats are warmer and remember you
Off: nothing is recorded or shared with chats (saved notes are kept)
Choose a model so Min can write notes. Until then, existing notes are still shared with new chats.
Needs a provider with an API key (a Claude subscription login cannot be used here).
Any provider works, not just the one you chat with. Notes are made about two minutes after a chat goes quiet, or when it closes, in one small request.
No notes yet. They appear after you chat with companion mode on.
Delete all companion notes? This cannot be undone. Past chats are not re-read afterwards.
